name: Hugo Peers
source:
Likes: Stew you cook
Dislikes: Vain
Hobby: Travelling
Skills: Camping

"I wondered why my heart always ached when I thought of her."

Lucious: Hugo has come from the future to change the tragic destiny...
He says if nothing improves, the world will follow the path of enteral destruction.
That's kind of scary...
I don't know whether he is telling the truth or not, but if he ever hurts her or bothers her, I will take him down!

[Official in-game description]
